integrity: Proof is based on complete finite acyclic-matching certificates for both pair types and a separate verified pair-orbit reduction, not on numerical homology fitting.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the seventeen-vertex Paley graph and deletion of exactly two vertices. Does not classify other orders, three or more deletions, integral equivariant modules or independent validation. Priority risk for unindexed tables and inaccessible full text remains.
title: Two-vertex punctures of the Paley-seventeen flag complex distinguish adjacent from nonadjacent pairs
